@s1 stated
  relation "be located in"
  role subject "Orhei Language School"
  role location "Piatra Neamț"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be located in"
  role subject "Focșani Language School"
  role location "Bălți"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "rely on"
  role subject "the search index"
  role object "the mail server"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "play for"
  role subject "Mr Oprea"
  role object "Galați United"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "rely on"
  role subject "the VPN gateway"
  role object "the login service"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s6 stated
  relation "depend on"
  role subject "the analytics pipeline"
  role object "the backup cluster"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s7 stated
  relation "treat"
  role subject "Paloma"
  role object "Alejandro"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s8 stated
  relation "treat"
  role subject "Florin Barbu"
  role object "Ionuț"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a dentist appointment"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  where match
    relation "go to"
    role subject "Petru"
    role object "Taylor Primary School"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "be a supplier of"
    role subject ?x
    role object "Nordwind Systems"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "require"
    role subject ?x
    role object "a criminal record certificate"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q4 query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "be a parent of"
    role subject "Hugo"
    role object ?x
    polarity affirmed
  end
